howItWorks.title: How Ozar Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Connect with trusted professionals in 4 simple steps. From search to completion, we've got you covered.

step1.title: Search for Services
step1.description: Browse through thousands of verified professionals. Use filters to find exactly what you need - by category, location, rating, or availability.
step1.point1: Search by service type or professional name
step1.point2: Filter by location, price, and ratings

step2.title: Connect & Discuss
step2.description: Message professionals directly to discuss your needs, ask questions, and get quotes. Our built-in chat makes communication easy and secure.
step2.point2: Share photos and details of your project

step3.title: Book & Schedule
step3.description: Once you've found the right professional, book their service with just a few clicks. Choose your preferred date and time, and you're all set!

step4.title: Get It Done & Review
step4.description: The professional completes the work, and you're all set! Leave a review to help others make informed decisions and build trust in our community.

trustSafety.title: Trust & Safety
trustSafety.subtitle: We're committed to creating a safe, secure, and trustworthy platform for everyone. Learn how we protect you every step of the way.

verification.title: Thoroughly Vetted Professionals
verification.description: Every professional on Ozar goes through a comprehensive verification process before they can offer services. We don't compromise on quality or safety.

background.title: Background Checks
background.description: Criminal record and professional history screening

payment.title: Your Money is Protected
payment.description: We use industry-leading payment processors and hold funds securely until the job is completed to your satisfaction. Your financial information is always encrypted and protected.

escrow.title: Escrow Protection
escrow.description: Funds held until work is completed and approved

reviews.title: Real Reviews from Real People
reviews.description: Our review system is built on transparency and authenticity. Only verified customers who have completed a booking can leave reviews, ensuring honest feedback.

privacy.title: Your Data, Your Control
privacy.description: We take your privacy seriously. Your personal information is protected with enterprise-grade security, and you have full control over your data at all times.

minimal.title: Minimal Data Collection
minimal.description: We only collect what's necessary for the service

secure.title: Secure Storage
secure.description: Data stored in encrypted, secure servers
